note: To add a plugin, add one entry to "plugins". Downloads are only listed once a real file exists; status "coming_soon" entries have no downloads.

plugins.name: Twitch
plugins.author: Nocto
plugins.description: Sign in to Twitch from inside Nocto (no stream key typing, no browser redirect server), edit your stream title, category and tags, and read and send chat in a dock next to your preview.
features: Sign in with a device code
Edit stream title, category and tags

plugins.name: Vignette (sample shader)
plugins.author: Nocto
plugins.description: Shader-only video filter: darkens the edges of a source. Strength, radius and tint. No compiler needed, and a good starting point for your own shader filters.
plugins.install: File > Plugins... > Open user plugins folder, copy the files from the zip into it, then enable the plugin in the Plugins window.

tools.name: Nocto Plugin SDK
tools.description: Header, CMake template and samples for writing native plugins and shader filters.
